逐条对照 C1 标准（`design == "RCT"` 且 `year >= 2018`）：

| id | year | design | 判定 |
|:---|:-----|:-------|:-----|
| S1 | 2020 | RCT | ✅ |
| S2 | 2016 | RCT | ❌ year < 2018 |
| S3 | 2019 | cohort | ❌ 非 RCT |
| S4 | 2021 | RCT | ✅ |
| S5 | 2018 | RCT | ✅ |
| S6 | 2015 | systematic review | ❌ 非 RCT |
| S7 | 2022 | RCT | ✅ |
| S8 | 2019 | case report | ❌ 非 RCT |
| S9 | 2023 | RCT | ✅ |
| S10 | 2017 | RCT | ❌ year < 2018 |

答案: S1, S4, S5, S7, S9
